full_judgment: Ruhul Islam C.J.-On an application filed by the petitioner in Writ Petition No. 495 of 1974 a Rule was issued calling upon the Opposite parties to show cause why they should not be committed for contempt of this Court for violating that order passed by this Court on 29th April, 1974. The then Deputy Commissioner, Dacca Syed Rezaul Hayat, issued a letter dated 11th November, 1975 to the Secretary, Ministry of Works and Urban Development, Government of the People's Republic of Bangladesh with a copy of the same issued under the endorsement of Mr. Mohammad Kurshed Alam, the then Additional Deputy Commissioner, Dacca to Mr. Matiur Rahman, a tenant under the petitioner in the eastern flat of the 1st floor of the building at the holding No. 118, Segun Bagicha, P. S. Ramna, Dacca, treating the same as Khas Mohal property under the administration of the Dacca Collectorate and allotting the western flat of the ground floor and western flat of the 1st floor of the building to Mr. Jasimuddin Ahmed Choudhury, Deputy Magistrate, Dacca and Mr. Md. Tozammal Islam, Deputy Magistrate, Dacca respectively for their residential purpose with a further direction therein for shifting the tenant Mr. Motiur Rahman; and that the present Deputy Commissioner Mr. Shaukat Ali is continuing in the violation of the said ad interim order of stay by not cancelling and/or rescinding the aforesaid subsequent order of allotment of the flat to the aforesaid allottees, Accordingly the said (1) Syed Rezaul Hayat, the then Deputy Commissioner, Dacca and now Member, Water Development Authority, Water and Power Development Authority, Bangladesh (2) Mr. Mohammad Khurshed Alam, the then Additional Deputy Commissioner and now Secretary, Jute Export Corporation, Segun Bagicha, Dacca, and (3) Mr. Shaukat Ali, the present Deputy Commissioner, Dacca are liable to be committed for Contempt of Court.
